newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LINEUPS FOR CHELSEA-WIMBLEDON FA CUP SEMIFINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LINEUPS FOR CHELSEA-WIMBLEDON FA CUP SEMIFINAL.

text.p: Lineups for the English F.A. Cup semifinal between Chelsea and Wimbledon at Highbury on Sunday:

Chelsea: 30-Frode Grodas; 20-Frank Sinclair, 5-Franck Lebouef, 6-Steve Clarke, 18-Erland Johnsen, 14-Craig Burley, 24-Eddie Newton, 11-Dennis Wise, 16-Roberto di Matteo, 25-Gianfranco Zola, 10-Mark Hughes
Wimbledon: 1-Neil Sullivan; 2-Kenny Cunningham, 5-Dean Blackwell, 12-Chris Perry, 3-Alan Kimble, 8-Robbie Earle, 4-Vinnie Jones, 18-Neal Ardley, 9-Efan Ekoku, 7-Oyvind Leonhardsen, 11-Marcus Gayle.
